submission.justification: Sensor-T2 has the best unirradiated resolution (6.0 um at 150 um) but its hit efficiency after 2e16 neq/cm^2 is 82.0%, far below the hard 97% requirement, so it is excluded. Sensor-T1 meets efficiency (99.2%) but has the worst resolution (14.0 um). Sensor-T3 meets the efficiency requirement (98.5% at 2e16 neq/cm^2) and gives 9.0 um resolution, the best among the candidates that pass. It is compatible with the 50x50 um readout chip and the CO2 cooling baseline. I chose 150 um because it is the only thickness for which resolution was simulated (2025 summary), and the documents give no thickness-dependence data for either resolution or post-irradiation efficiency. Caveat: the 2025 resolution figure is unirradiated, and the 98.5% efficiency is measured at a thickness not explicitly stated in the campaign report, so a thickness-specific irradiated efficiency check is advisable before finalizing; thinner options were not evaluated and could improve resolution but may reduce post-irradiation signal and efficiency.

requirements.evidence: Sensor-T3 is a listed candidate (planar, standard pitch).
irradiation_testbeam_2026.md and query_irradiation: Sensor-T3 98.5% at 2e16 neq/cm^2. Caveat: campaign thickness not stated; not verified at 150 um specifically.

Among the efficiency-passing candidates, Sensor-T3 gives 9.0 um vs 14.0 um for Sensor-T1 (2025 simulation, 150 um, unirradiated). Sensor-T2 (6.0 um) is excluded by efficiency. No thickness optimization was possible from available data.
